description: This file defines an abstract class providing common validation functionality for header values in a software system. It manages responsibility for validation based on Java types and enforces certain validation patterns, serving as a base class for specific validators.

classes.name: AbstractHeaderValueValidator
classes.description: An abstract base class that implements the ValueValidator interface, providing common validation logic for header values, including responsibility determination based on Java type and null checks.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Validates the given header definition and value if this validator is responsible for the header's Java type.

methods.name: canValidate
methods.description: Checks if the validator is responsible for validating values of the specified Java type.

methods.name: andThen
methods.description: Chains this validator with another, allowing sequential validation steps.
